CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content presentation/emergence.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red/blue coordinate sets) and an explicit origin/presentation metadata are given for the same referent/time, and origin is presented separately from the coordinate content.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit coordinate sets named by color for a named referent/time.

D.rationale: Origin metadata (kind/record_time) is presented separately from the coordinate content, distinguishing content identity from its status/origin.

O.rationale: The report states how the content is presented/accessed via explicit origin metadata for the named referent/time.
